units.rawText: I didn't like KTVs much in the past; they were noisy and hardly interesting at all.
units.displayText: I didn't like KTVs much in the past; they were noisy and hardly interesting at all.

spans.text: I didn't like KTVs much in the past; they were noisy and hardly interesting at all.

units.rawText: However! One good thing about KTVs is that you can listen to songs from <color=orange>"NotREAL?"</color> there.
units.displayText: However! One good thing about KTVs is that you can listen to songs from "NotREAL?" there.

spans.text: However! One good thing about KTVs is that you can listen to songs from
"NotREAL?"
there.

units.rawText: Especially Nanaka's songs. Those guys who sing along with the original track really know what they're doing.
units.displayText: Especially Nanaka's songs. Those guys who sing along with the original track really know what they're doing.

units.rawText: Thanks, KTV Agent 7, for the three Ejector Seats! But I don't use them because I've never lost them before, hahaha!
units.displayText: Thanks, KTV Agent 7, for the three Ejector Seats! But I don't use them because I've never lost them before, hahaha!

spans.text: Thanks, KTV Agent 7, for the three Ejector Seats! But I don't use them because I've never lost them before, hahaha!

units.rawText: (Sighs) If Nanaka were in Burbank, all she'd have to do is sing, and everyone would understand the true meaning of entertainment.
units.displayText: (Sighs) If Nanaka were in Burbank, all she'd have to do is sing, and everyone would understand the true meaning of entertainment.

spans.text: (Sighs) If Nanaka were in Burbank, all she'd have to do is sing, and everyone would understand the true meaning of entertainment.

units.rawText: I mean, <color=orange>"Hello! Fantastic World"</color> is like the Bible of the music world, you get what I mean, right?
units.displayText: I mean, "Hello! Fantastic World" is like the Bible of the music world, you get what I mean, right?

"Hello! Fantastic World"
is like the Bible of the music world, you get what I mean, right?

units.rawText: Are you done spouting buzzwords yet? When are you getting down from there?
units.displayText: Are you done spouting buzzwords yet? When are you getting down from there?

spans.text: Are you done spouting buzzwords yet? When are you getting down from there?

units.rawText: Kuro looks down.
units.displayText: Kuro looks down.

spans.text: Kuro looks down.

units.rawText: The previously empty stage is now occupied by a Sanctifier wielding a gigantic axe.
units.displayText: The previously empty stage is now occupied by a Sanctifier wielding a gigantic axe.

spans.text: The previously empty stage is now occupied by a Sanctifier wielding a gigantic axe.

units.rawText: She meets Kuro's gaze and beckons to her with a finger.
units.displayText: She meets Kuro's gaze and beckons to her with a finger.

spans.text: She meets Kuro's gaze and beckons to her with a finger.

units.rawText: Alright, looks like contestant Reverence is ready and on stage!
units.displayText: Alright, looks like contestant Reverence is ready and on stage!

spans.text: Alright, looks like contestant Reverence is ready and on stage!

units.rawText: Looks like the hero she's using today is—
units.displayText: Looks like the hero she's using today is—

spans.text: Looks like the hero she's using today is—

units.rawText: Cut the crap and get down from there already! Or are you wimping out on me?
units.displayText: Cut the crap and get down from there already! Or are you wimping out on me?

spans.text: Cut the crap and get down from there already! Or are you wimping out on me?

units.rawText: <size=40>Who's wimping out on who, you skank!?</size>
units.displayText: Who's wimping out on who, you skank!?

spans.text: Who's wimping out on who, you skank!?

units.rawText: Do you think you're all that just because you brought a few low-level Sanctifiers along? Watch me blow them all to bits in one shot!
units.displayText: Do you think you're all that just because you brought a few low-level Sanctifiers along? Watch me blow them all to bits in one shot!

spans.text: Do you think you're all that just because you brought a few low-level Sanctifiers along? Watch me blow them all to bits in one shot!

units.rawText: Oh? Don't come crying to me when I chop all your bullets out of the sky!
units.displayText: Oh? Don't come crying to me when I chop all your bullets out of the sky!

spans.text: Oh? Don't come crying to me when I chop all your bullets out of the sky!

units.rawText: The streaming studio dives down, and Reverence raises her axe to engage. An intense battle unfolds on the stage.
units.displayText: The streaming studio dives down, and Reverence raises her axe to engage. An intense battle unfolds on the stage.

spans.text: The streaming studio dives down, and Reverence raises her axe to engage. An intense battle unfolds on the stage.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, the stream camera follows their battle, broadcasting it live to the entire Sector...
